_about: Q7 step 1 (docs/UI_HUD2_PRESETS.md 6 step 1): the HUD 2 presets' layout data as a top-level spec key. Apply to docs/UI_SPEC.json and to the artifact's ui/spec document with specpatch.py (op 'top'); the mock-up's JS needs none of it (the page carries unknown top-level keys through applySpec and saves them back).

hud2_presets._about: HUD 2's four layout presets as docs/UI_HUD2_PRESETS.md revision 2 decides them (the owner, 29-30 Oct 2026; NOT built: section 6 step 8). Units: fractions of screen height H at 16:9, k = 1, from the top-left (the screen is 1.778 H wide, centre 0.889, 0.50); a field ending _w is a fraction of W; d* fields are offsets from the screen centre; a budget is a fraction of the screen's area ('boxed' = plates only), *_area in H squared. Every number's 'src' names its section of docs/UI_HUD2_PRESETS.md ('PRESETS <section>'); a value from another doc says so. 'open' lists what the doc leaves open (null fields = not given). Generated into core/ui_meta.h (namespace uimeta::hud2p) by tools/ui_meta.py: the shared numbers, each preset's complete zones ('lint': true), boxed-budget caps, prompt caps, the value ids; the lint (controller/src/impl/hud2_lint.h) reads Standard's from there.
